subject: General Knowledge
description: Indian firsts across science, exploration, public offices

questions.explanation: Tagore — first Indian/Asian Nobel (Literature 1913). First Indian science Nobel: C.V. Raman (Physics, 1930). First woman Indian Nobel: Mother Teresa (Peace, 1979). First in Economics: Amartya Sen (1998).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The FIRST Chief Justice of India was:
questions.explanation: Harilal Jekisundas Kania — first CJI of India (26 January 1950 to 6 November 1951). Died in office. 17th CJI P.N. Bhagwati (1985-86) championed PILs. Current CJI (2025): Sanjiv Khanna (succeeded D.Y. Chandrachud in Nov 2024).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the FIRST with the PERSON. A. First CAG.  B. First Vice-President.  C. First Chief Election Commissioner.  D. First Attorney-General. List-II: 1. V. Narahari Rao.  2. Dr. S. Radhakrishnan.  3. Sukumar Sen.  4. M. C. Setalvad.
questions.explanation: First CAG — V. Narahari Rao (1948). First VP — Dr. Radhakrishnan (1952-62). First CEC — Sukumar Sen (1950, held 1951-52 first general elections). First AG — M. C. Setalvad (1950-63, longest-serving).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The FIRST Indian to be AWARDED the Nobel Peace Prize was:
questions.explanation: Mother Teresa — 1979 Nobel Peace Prize. Indian citizen since 1948. Kailash Satyarthi — Peace Prize 2014, shared with Malala. Mahatma Gandhi was nominated 5 times but never awarded (the Nobel committee later publicly expressed regret).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The first Indian COMMERCIAL SATELLITE (communications) was:
questions.explanation: APPLE — Ariane Passenger Payload Experiment — first experimental geostationary communications satellite of India; launched 19 June 1981 by European Ariane rocket from French Guiana. Aryabhata (1975) was India's first satellite (scientific, not commercial). INSAT-1A launched 1982.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The FIRST INDIAN MOVIE to be released in colour was:
questions.explanation: Kisan Kanya — 1937, Ardeshir Irani (also the man behind 1931 Alam Ara — India's first talkie). Directed by Moti B. Gidwani. Raja Harishchandra (1913) was India's first feature (silent). Sholay (1975) was a later blockbuster, not first colour film.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The FIRST INDIAN to scale Mount Everest WITHOUT oxygen was:
questions.explanation: Phu Dorjee — Nepal-born Indian climber; first INDIAN to scale Everest solo (1984). However, first Indian to do so WITHOUT supplemental oxygen is commonly cited as him or varies by source. Tenzing Norgay (1953 with Edmund Hillary) used oxygen and was ethnically Sherpa but Indian citizen later.
